QuestInfo.name: The style festival is in progress.
QuestInfo.0:
Big Headger is happy he can show off his sewing skills with the Masterpiece Machine!
He says he'll start a whole style festival with all this happiness.
Talk to him about Royal Style and Masterpiece Machine and 
participate in the style festival!
